title: Returning to previous spot after water hazard
question: If your shot ends up in a yellow penalty area and you don't want to drop behind the hazard, what other relief option do you have?

choices.text: You must play the ball where it lies in the penalty area.
You can go back to where you last played the shot and play again, taking a one-stroke penalty.
You may drop the ball on the green without penalty.
You can only keep playing if you find your original ball.

explanation: You can go back to the spot of your last shot and play again from there for a one-stroke penalty. If your previous shot was from the tee, you are allowed to tee up as well.
